text:
Ava M.: Quick one — finalizing the newsletter launch cadence for the benchmark report. Thinking a 3-email nurture over 10 days, staggered by region (NA/EU/APAC) with local send windows. Flag any reasons not to do this?
Sam G.: sounds fine. main thing is segment by trial activity + last-engaged date, not just region. prioritize 'active trials last 30d' for the first send.
Lee C.: subject ideas (A/B):
```
A: Benchmark report: 3 ways to cut inference cost by 2x
B: New benchmark — cutting LLM token cost without losing quality
C: How teams are shaving latency and cost (benchmark inside)
```
Lee C.: short preview lines too: "Benchmarks from prod workloads — 5 pages" vs "Real numbers from infra teams"
Dan O.: ESP notes — sending 3 waves will hit throttles if we target >150k in a window. we should do micro-batches per region + progressive ramp (30%/40%/30%). also confirm suppression lists (no-send to customers in active private deployments by default).
Ava M.: good call. Sam, can you share the segments + estimated counts by EOD? put numbers in the shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/benchmark-launch (also added a heatmap tab — please check)
Sam G.: added counts for NA/EU/APAC and split by activity. active trials 12k, engaged drop-offs 28k, cold list 90k. I recommend seeding cold list later and excluding known SCCs.
Priya K.: I can run a quick QA on tracking params and UTM templates. prefer `utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1` and `utm_content` for subject variant. also want click tests for the hero CTA + webinar sign-up link.
Ava M.: thanks. let's A/B subject lines in wave 1 only, roll winners to waves 2+3. schedule windows: NA 10am local, EU 10am CET, APAC 10am SGT. Dan — can you set progressive ramp and confirm throttles with ESP by tomorrow?
Dan O.: on it. will set ramp and enable per-region batching. will also create a suppression segment for any customers with private deployments.
mailbot: deploy-schedule: sends scheduled for 2025-07-03 14:00 UTC (NA wave 1) · status: pending
Priya K.: QA done for tracking. I left notes in sheet, and added a test row with sample UTM'd link.
Ava M.: perfect. next steps: Sam finalizes segments, Dan configures ramp, Lee locks subject lines and preview copy. we'll sync tomorrow 11am PT for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
